_about: Pricing policy. The website publishes NO prices or price ranges. The assistant must never quote one.

chunks.title: Pricing policy: custom quotes
chunks.text: GURU AI works on custom quotes per project. There are no published fixed prices, rate cards or price ranges, and the assistant cannot estimate a price. A quote is prepared from the requirements (features, scale, timeline). The website says a clear custom quote usually follows within 24 hours of sharing requirements on WhatsApp or the contact form. Budgets can be shared optionally when starting an enquiry; this does not commit either side.
